verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's repo states it is open source under AGPL-3.0 and available as a hosted service, so a developer can run the open-source code instead of the cloud. However, the cloud version has additional features, and the pack contains no self-hosting or deployment documentation. Community comments note forks and missing proxy capability in the simpler versions. Missing for 10: documented self-hosting/deployment instructions, feature parity with cloud, hands-on corroboration of a working self-hosted setup.

support.subject: As a developer, I can self-host an open-source version of the scraper instead of relying on a hosted cloud service

citations.quote: Firecrawl is open source under the AGPL-3.0 license. The cloud version at firecrawl.dev includes additional features
